description.source: Authored contrast profile: the same natural Ethiopian component Hologram uses, taken on its own at a lighter roast.
limitations: Authored priors, not measurements. Present so the catalogue spans a range wide enough for axis differences to be visible at all.
A light roast retains more chlorogenic acids and unreacted sugars and builds fewer melanoidins. That ordering is well established; these values are chosen to express it, not derived from an assay.
